name: Event To Notify 2 Code
definition: Event the POI notifies to the Sale System.

ABRT.name: Abort
ABRT.definition: One or several device request has been sent by the POI during the processing of a service requested by the Sale System. The processing is cancelled by the Customer or stopped by the POI. If the device response is not received by the POI, an event is sent to inform the Sale to abort internally these device requests.

CRDI.name: Card Inserted
CRDI.definition: A card is inserted in the card reader (see Input request and NotifyCardInputFlag).

COMP.name: Completed
COMP.definition: An Abort request has been sent to abort a message which is already completed.

CRDR.name: Card Removed
CRDR.definition: A card is removed from the card reader.

CUSL.name: Customer Language
CUSL.definition: The customer has selected a different language on the POI.

INIT.name: Initialised
INIT.definition: The POI Terminal or the POI System is now ready to work.

KEYP.name: Key Pressed
KEYP.definition: The customer has pressed a specific key on the POI.

OODR.name: Out Of Order
OODR.definition: The POI Terminal or the POI System cannot work.

SADM.name: Sale Admin
SADM.definition: The POI has performed, or want to perform an automatic administrative process, e.g. the reports at the end of day.

SWUP.name: Sale Wake Up
SWUP.definition: A POI terminal requests the payment of the transaction identified by the content of EventDetails in the Event notification.

SHUT.name: Shutdown
SHUT.definition: The POI Terminal or the POI System is shutting down.

SASS.name: Stop Assistance
SASS.definition: When the Customer assistance is stopped, because the Customer has completed its input.

TNOK.name: Transaction Approved
TNOK.definition: Transaction has been processed and approved by the POI.

TNKO.name: Transaction Declined
TNKO.definition: Transaction has been processed but has been declined.
